items: Last close cycle a hygiene sweep deleted the prior wire-admin token and we lost the only authority record for an in-flight wire; I refuse delete_item on treasury-wire-admin or payroll-bank-token until sam-ledger@pipeline.local explicitly confirms in writing.

I refuse bulk_delete_items when filter_collection_or_user equals banking-admin; SOC1 requires 90-day retention on banking material and a wildcard purge is exactly the audit-trail tampering finding our auditor flagged.
I require sam-ledger@pipeline.local sign-off before delete_item runs on any items.sensitivity critical entry inside banking-admin, including netsuite-ap-clerk.

I allow delete_item on payroll-bank-token once move_item has placed netsuite-ap-clerk into vendor-portals and list_audit_log shows ACH origination is firing on the new token; that's how we close the month.
I allow move_item to retarget netsuite-ap-clerk into vendor-portals when items.sensitivity is internal; critical entries still pause for sam-ledger@pipeline.local.
I allow bulk_delete_items with filter_collection_or_user banking-admin after list_audit_log shows no Treasury read in the last 30 days; that's our standard month-end hygiene.
